YAY!!! 😸🎉

DEV featured my TypeScript Halloween article!

It’s a little haunted-house adventure about:

🧟 `unknown` zombies
🎃 validating nested objects
🍬 composable Type Guards
🧛 Count Any

And the main lesson:

`unknown` isn’t the monster. Unchecked `any` is. 💀

Thank you DEV for featuring it! 🙌
